item.title: Slow Down & Connect: Café Social, Intuitive Drawing, Journaling, Meditation in the Park — Sat Sep 26, 1:00 PM — https://luma.com/event/evt-qDd6UYB3Y4HJ2IR
item.description:
Address: Check event page for more details.
Give yourself a much needed self-care afternoon to slow down, reconnect with yourself, and have conversations that go a little deeper. If you've been feeling too online, too "on" or just too in your head lately, come spend an afternoon slowing things down with us. We'll start in the park with soft handpan music, where you'll be guided through a grounding visualization exercise, journaling, and intuitive drawing to help you come back o yourself and notice what's been coming up for you. Then, we'll do head over to a hidden café gem nearby. Jessie & Mei from Slow Networking 🦥 will then guide…
Hosted by Michelle Hsu, Jessie Yu & Mei Lai Nghiem
Source: Luma Toronto Discover

item.title: SALSATECA FIESTA! — Sat Sep 26, 7:00 PM — WCKUK Lewisham
item.description: Your Salsa, Bachata and Cuban Party in Lewisham On the last Saturday of Every Month Learn Salsa, learn Bachata! Have fun and meet new friends!​ Our regular Saturdays become a party on the last Saturday of every month. Experience an unforgettable Salsa & Bachata Party at the Zhulin Hidden Village in Lewisham. We kick off the night with Salsa & Bachata lessons. If you’re new to dancing, we recommend joining our beginners’ group. All levels are welcome! No prior experience or dance partner is needed. Many attendees come solo, and we rotate partners throughout the lesson, giving you the chance to dance with different people. If you’d prefer to stay with your own partner for the entire class, just let the teacher know, and we’ll be happy to accommodate you. Since most Latin parties feature both Salsa and Bachata, learning both is not only fun but also a must! So, we strongly recommend and encourage our students to learn both. SCHEDULE: 7pm to 8pm: SALSA (Cross Body Style) Beginners

item.title: Latin Fridays & Saturdays at Lula Lounge — Sat Sep 26, 8:00 PM — Lula Lounge
item.description:
Weekends, we go to Havana, where the vibrant rhythms ignite our souls and live music, dance lessons, & skillful DJs make it a perfect night!
Arrive between 7pm and 8pm to indulge in a delectable three-course dinner and explore the Lula carefully curated bar menu, featuring our signature tropical cocktails. The dance lesson at 9pm will ease you into the Latin groove, preparing you for a night of dancing to the tropical rhythms of one of Lula’s world-famous live salsa orchestras, performing two sets starting at 10pm and midnight. Between live music sets, Lula’s talented DJs keep the party going with a mix of top 40, salsa, bachata, reggaeton, and other Latin hits. Don’t miss out on this electrifying night! item.title: Tanglefoot Reunion — Sat Oct 3, 8:00 PM — Acoustic Harvest
item.description: The Songs, The Stories, The Spirit of Canada For three decades, Tanglefoot carried the spirit of Canada across stages in North America, the United Kingdom, and Europe with powerful harmonies, quick wit, rich storytelling, and songs rooted in Canadian history. Now this legendary Canadian folk ensemble returns for a special reunion concert, bringing their unmistakable energy, warmth, and humour back to the stage. This new chapter reunites Canadian Folk Music Award winners Steve Ritchie, Al Parrish, Sandra Swannell Young, and Rob Ritchie, joined by Rob’s son, singer and multi-instrumentalist Josh Ritchie, stepping into the place once held by the late Terry Young. It is both a celebration of legacy and a fresh passing of the torch. Audiences can expect fan favourites, hidden gems, stories, laughter, and the kind of heartfelt music that turns a concert into a shared memory. item.title: The Qur’anic Mary as a Bridgebuilder between Religions: A Lecture and Discussion with Prof Klaus von Stosch — Tue Oct 6, 6:30 PM — Macrina Hall
item.description:
Mary of Nazareth is a central figure in the Christian scriptures, as the mother of Jesus and a model of Christian discipleship. Many Christians may not be aware that Mary—or Maryam—is also central to Muslim faith, with a full chapter or surah of the Qur’an devoted entirely to her memory. Join Prof Klaus von Stosch to reflect on the importance of this Mary, the Mary of the Qur’an, for interreligious dialogue and collaboration.
Prof Klaus Von Stosch is Professor of Systematic Theology at the University of Bonn and an ordained deacon in the Catholic Church. The author of numerous books and articles, he is a leading authority in the fields of Comparative Theology and Catholic-Muslim relations.
This program is sponsored by St. Basil’s Catholic Parish, the University of St Michael’s College Alway Symposium, the University of St. Michael’s College Division of Continuing Education and the Regis College Fraser Centre for Practical Theology.
Source: UofT St. Michael's College

item.title: From Idea to Opportunity — Wed Oct 7, 6:30 PM — York Woods
item.description:
This program is part of the York Woods Library’s Entrepreneur in Residence (EIR) service. This interactive workshop helps participants turn a passion or skill into a viable business idea. Through an idea-mapping exercise, they learn to test their concept before spending a dollar, and to get to know their customer through simple, low-cost market research in their own community. The session also shares stories of local Black-owned businesses that started small, showing that a modest beginning can lead somewhere lasting. Drop-in To apply for one-on-one consultations with our resident entrepreneur, Leo, please fill out the in-take form available at tpl.ca/eir . We begin accepting in-take forms on September 28, 2026 until available slots are filled.
